scope: Read-only preview classic header import with declared native admission policy
trigger: One initial read after session opens; explicit View > Reload Saved Column Layout; ordinary Refresh does not import headers
excluded: All other original IDs,including size/remaining/done/down/#; no label/case/plugin/private saved-value aliases
visibility: Only explicit validated requested facts; missing/malformed facts leave session state unchanged
width: Signed-low32 requested width16..8192; Qt minimum still applies; responsive Stretch Name width deliberately unapplied
order: Unique nonnegative positions among matched IDs, compacted ahead of unchanged native sections in their current relative order; duplicates reject only ordering facet
sort: Only current SortColumns singleton exact whitelisted ID with explicit known direction; existing native UserRole comparator, not Java comparator equivalence
session_precedence: Unique nonzero profile session and monotonic request identity; initial applies only to untouched panes; explicit reload captures local revisions; later per-pane edits/Reset win
lifecycle: Separate coalesced worker request, bounded owned packet, cancellation on queued delivery, busy-held result signal and deletion guards; retained off-tab widgets are not reopened or focused by result
reset: Original preview construction defaults remain reset baseline; no save/reload/default migration
limitations: No registered column defaults, plugin column widgets, legacy global-sort resolution, row-height/color/tooltip/title/icon application or config writer
No full Java effective-layout/row-sort or seamless switching qualification
A synchronous newer request/edit can abort remaining apply; already-applied header changes are not transactionally rolled back
